South Africa Dethrones Australia to Claim ICC Men's Test Team Rankings Summit

31 Oct 2026, 07:37 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Editorial Desk · Source: www.icc-cricket.com

2 min read

Key takeawaysAccording to an official update published by the International Cricket Council (ICC), the South African men's cricket team has climbed to the summit of the ICC Men's Test Team Rankings. The achievement follows a commanding bowling performance on the final day of the third Test, which secured a series victory over Australia.

South Africa Claims Number One Spot

According to an official update published by the International Cricket Council (ICC), the South African men's cricket team has climbed to the summit of the ICC Men's Test Team Rankings. The achievement follows a commanding bowling performance on the final day of the third Test, which secured a series victory over Australia.

Following the update, South Africa holds the top position with a rating of 124. Australia dropped to second place with a rating of 122. The remainder of the top five features New Zealand with 106 rating points, India with 105, and England with 102.

Series Results and Match Context

The rankings update is the result of a hard-fought three-match Test series between the recent ICC World Test Championship finalists. The series unfolded across multiple venues:

  • First Test (Durban): Australia opened the series with a comprehensive 214-run victory.
  • Second Test (Gqeberha): South Africa responded with an innings and 31-run triumph on home soil.
  • Third Test (Cape Town): After momentum shifted across the final match, South Africa's bowlers dismissed the Australian batting lineup on Day 5 to secure a 176-run victory.

World Test Championship Implications

Beyond the team rankings summit, the series outcome impacts the ICC World Test Championship standings. South Africa has returned to the top two positions in the current cycle.

Meanwhile, New Zealand has moved to the top of the World Test Championship standings. New Zealand and Australia are scheduled to face each other in a four-Test series later this year as part of the ongoing cycle.

Practical Implications and Verification

The updated standings affect the ongoing race for the fourth ICC World Test Championship Final, which is scheduled to take place at The Oval next year, featuring the top two ranked teams in the standings at the end of the qualification period.

Fans and analysts seeking to verify these rankings and explore potential future scenarios can consult the official ICC website, which provides the complete standings tables and the official Team Rankings Predictor tool.
